title: Bounded Resumable Cache Retention and Delete Tombstones

observed_problem.risk: A local delete could be recorded confirmed while retry-only partial stems or staging bytes survived; interrupted caches also had no TTL/count/total-byte reclamation.

implemented_contracts: A43 resumable cache policy bounds inactive retry caches by TTL, entry count, and total bytes.
Per-job external lock files live outside deletable cache directories and protect active output collection from reclamation.
Future access timestamps and unsafe symlink/special-file cache surfaces are removed fail-closed.
A durable per-job delete tombstone survives cache deletion and process restart.
A43 production start and output collection reject a tombstoned logical job.
Budgeted production rejects a tombstoned job before source containment/hash, duration analysis, cost reservation, upload, or provider work.
PrivacyRetentionService tombstones and purges retry cache before local confirmation and also removes committed plus .staging job directories.
Explicit retention expiry uses the same tombstone/cache/staging-aware local deletion path.
Maintenance purge remains distinct from privacy deletion and does not create a permanent tombstone.

scope: committed/staging/cache absence before modeled local confirmation
isolated_interface_harness.claim_limit: Interface-compatible model validation only; not repository-native unittest discovery.

non_claims: No physical-iPhone long-track memory, thermal, battery, or storage-pressure campaign was executed.
No live provider strong-ETag/Range/If-Range campaign was executed.
No exact repository-native A43 full unittest discovery was observed.
No multi-host distributed cache authority is claimed; external lease protects same shared filesystem host/processes only.
P021 and P024 remain MISSING until HQ-required live/integrated evidence is satisfied.
